title: Fish Farming: Red Fish
description: Fish Farming: Red Fish — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Sir Temdewm

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Collect 15 Red Fish.

Quest Reward: 2,125 Gold.

Return to: Sir Temdewm

Repeatable: Yes

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Go and Collect 15 Red Fish from the Fade Leaders and Bring them back to Sir Tendewm on Level 2 of Vergrim's Vexation.

Offer:

Red Fish, whatever that is, is the next item on the list. You have collected these before so it shouldn't be a problem getting more. There is only one catch, the Fade Leaders have begun to horde the fish as a result of our over-fishing. You are going to have to target them to get what you need. Once you have collected all the fish return to me, Sir Tendewm, here on Level 2 of Vergrim's Vexation for your reward.

Turn-in:

Ok, looks like you have all the fish that were needed. Here is a little something for you. Let me know when you are ready to get started again.

Objectives:

  • Red Fish ×15

Client level range: 17–30
